## cw

```text
cw — header 4 bytes

Fields (bit width, running byte offset):
  first_nibble         bit<4>    @0
  flags                bit<4>    @0+4b
  length               bit<8>    @1
  sequence             bit<16>   @2

Dispatched from: mpls
Dispatches to:
  via              -> eth
```

```text
esp — header 8 bytes

Dispatched from: ipv4, ipv6
```

```text
eth — header 14 bytes
```

## geneve

```text
geneve — header 8 bytes minimum (variable layout, see Notes)

Fields (bit width, running byte offset):
  version              bit<2>    @0
  opt_len              bit<6>    @0+2b
  flags                bit<8>    @1
  protocol_type        bit<16>   @2
  vni                  bit<24>   @4
  reserved             bit<8>    @7

Aux headers:
  gwlb (geneve_opt_gwlb_h, 8 bytes found by the option walk)
    option_class         bit<16>   @0
    type                 bit<8>    @2
    flags_len            bit<8>    @3
    flow_cookie          bit<32>   @4
    use: geneve.gwlb.<field>  or  geneve[gwlb.<field> == X]
  ovn (geneve_opt_ovn_h, 8 bytes found by the option walk)
    option_class         bit<16>   @0
    type                 bit<8>    @2
    flags_len            bit<8>    @3
    rsv                  bit<1>    @4
    ingress_port         bit<15>   @4+1b
    egress_port          bit<16>   @6
    use: geneve.ovn.<field>  or  geneve[ovn.<field> == X]

Options walk (parsed by parser block, 2 named options):
  GWLB (8 bytes)
    option_class         bit<16>   @0
    type                 bit<8>    @2
    flags_len            bit<8>    @3
    flow_cookie          bit<32>   @4
    use: geneve.options.GWLB.<field>
  OVN (8 bytes)
    option_class         bit<16>   @0
    type                 bit<8>    @2
    flags_len            bit<8>    @3
    rsv                  bit<1>    @4
    ingress_port         bit<15>   @4+1b
    egress_port          bit<16>   @6
    use: geneve.options.OVN.<field>

Dispatched from: udp
Dispatches to:
  via              -> eth

Notes:
  parser state machine (variable extension headers or self-validation)
```

```text
gre — header 4 bytes minimum (variable layout, see Notes)
```

## gtp

```text
gtp — header 8 bytes minimum (variable layout, see Notes)

Fields (bit width, running byte offset):
  version              bit<3>    @0
  pt                   bit<1>    @0+3b
  reserved             bit<1>    @0+4b
  e                    bit<1>    @0+5b
  s                    bit<1>    @0+6b
  pn                   bit<1>    @0+7b
  msg_type             bit<8>    @1
  length               bit<16>   @2
  teid                 bit<32>   @4

Aux headers:
  opt (gtp_opt_h, 4 bytes @ +8 from layer start) (gated: (byte@0 & 0x7) != 0x0)
    seq                  bit<16>   @0
    npdu                 bit<8>    @2
    next_ext             bit<8>    @3
    use: gtp.opt.<field>  or  gtp[opt.<field> == X]

Aux header stacks:
  exts[0..8] (gtp_ext_h × 4 bytes each)
    ext_length           bit<8>    @0
    ext_type             bit<16>   @1
    next_ext             bit<8>    @3
    use: gtp.exts[N].<field>            static index
         gtp.exts[<primary_field>].<field>  dynamic index
         where any(gtp.exts.<field> == X)  quantifier (∃)
         where all(gtp.exts.<field> == X)  quantifier (∀)

Dispatched from: udp

Notes:
  parser state machine (variable extension headers or self-validation)
```

```text
Options walk (parsed by parser block, 2 named options):

    kind                 bit<8>    @0

Dispatched from: eth, gre, qinq, srv6, vlan
```

```text
         where all(ipv6.exts.<field> == X)  quantifier (∀)

Dispatched from: eth, gre, qinq, vlan
Dispatches to:
  via next_header  -> esp, gre, icmp6, srv6, tcp, udp

Notes:
  parser state machine (variable extension headers or self-validation)
```

```text
tcp — header 20 bytes minimum (variable layout, see Notes)

Fields (bit width, running byte offset):

  data_offset          bit<4>    @12
  reserved             bit<3>    @12+4b
  flags                bit<9>    @12+7b

  checksum             bit<16>   @16

    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    value                bit<16>   @2
    use: tcp.mss.<field>  or  tcp[mss.<field> == X]
  sack (tcp_opt_sack_h, 2 bytes found by the option walk)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    use: tcp.sack.<field>  or  tcp[sack.<field> == X]
  sack_perm (tcp_opt_sack_perm_h, 2 bytes found by the option walk)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    use: tcp.sack_perm.<field>  or  tcp[sack_perm.<field> == X]
  ts (tcp_opt_ts_h, 10 bytes found by the option walk)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    tsval                bit<32>   @2
    tsecr                bit<32>   @6
    use: tcp.ts.<field>  or  tcp[ts.<field> == X]
  ws (tcp_opt_ws_h, 3 bytes found by the option walk)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    shift                bit<8>    @2
    use: tcp.ws.<field>  or  tcp[ws.<field> == X]

Aux header stacks:
  blocks[0..3] (tcp_sack_block_h × 8 bytes each)
    left                 bit<32>   @0
    right                bit<32>   @4
    use: tcp.blocks[N].<field>            static index
         tcp.blocks[<primary_field>].<field>  dynamic index
         where any(tcp.blocks.<field> == X)  quantifier (∃)
         where all(tcp.blocks.<field> == X)  quantifier (∀)

Options walk (parsed by parser block, 5 named options):
  MSS (4 bytes)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    value                bit<16>   @2
    use: tcp.options.MSS.<field>
  SACK (2 bytes)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    use: tcp.options.SACK.<field>
  SACK_PERM (2 bytes)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    use: tcp.options.SACK_PERM.<field>
  TS (10 bytes)
    kind                 bit<8>    @0
    length               bit<8>    @1
    tsval                bit<32>   @2
    tsecr                bit<32>   @6
    use: tcp.options.TS.<field>

Dispatched from: ipv4, ipv6, srv6
```
